visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair, wearing a white lace headband and a matching white lace top, sits in a brightly lit indoor environment. She holds three colorful makeup boxes from the brand 'Charmiss,' featuring teddy bear illustrations, and gestures toward the camera with an enthusiastic expression. (2) She opens a teal box to reveal a small, round pink stick. She twists the base to expose a white, pearlescent product and applies it to the back of her hand, demonstrating a shimmering, light-reflective glow under the studio lights while looking at the camera. (3) Next, she unboxes a pink and yellow package, revealing a vibrant fuchsia-colored stick. She applies this to her hand, showcasing its glossy, jelly-like texture that appears pigmented on her skin. She shows the stick and the swatch closely to the lens. (4) She opens a blue box containing a blue-colored stick. Upon applying it to her skin, the blue tint transforms into a soft, sheer pink. She expresses surprise through facial expressions and wide eyes while holding the stick next to the swatch for comparison. (5) Transitioning to facial application, she dabs the fuchsia stick on her left cheek and blends it with her fingertips. She then layers the white highlighter stick on her cheekbones and the tip of her nose, creating a dewy finish. (6) She applies the blue color-changing stick to her right cheek. She points to both cheeks, demonstrating the subtle differences in color and the overall natural look of the product before posing with the sticks and smiling.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天呢來開箱我在泰國買的腮紅. [Logo]: Charmiss Jelly Joy 腮紅棒. (2) [Subtitle]: 它的腮紅包裝長這樣. (3) [Subtitle]: 這個看起來是一個打亮棒哦. (4) [Subtitle]: 先試在手上看看. [Slogan]: 光澤感還不錯. (5) [Subtitle]: 這個粉色總應該是腮紅了吧. (6) [Subtitle]: 顏色比較像是櫻桃果凍的顏色. [Variety]: 🍒. (7) [Subtitle]: 很像唇蜜的那種質感. (8) [Subtitle]: 藍色的是用來做什麼? (9) [Subtitle]: 喔! 它是會變色的耶. (10) [Subtitle]: 它塗在手上變成透透的淡粉色. (11) [Subtitle]: 先來試這個腮紅. [Slogan]: #04 Eve&Joy. (12) [Subtitle]: 質地不會太黏. (13) [Subtitle]: 而且顯色度還蠻明顯的. (14) [Subtitle]: 我們再來疊加它剛剛這個珠光. [Slogan]: 蘋果肌. [Slogan]: #01 Soda pop. (15) [Variety]: 哇! 好亮喔. (16) [Subtitle]: 腮紅顯色度好像可以再更好. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們就來上這個藍色款的腮紅. [Slogan]: #02 Sugar on me. (18) [Subtitle]: 可是我覺得這個粉好像更加自然. (19) [Subtitle]: 其實這兩個腮紅呢 我覺得它的顏色差異不太大. (20) [Subtitle]: 算是蠻好推勻的. (21) [Subtitle]: 開箱分享到這邊.
